# @weng-lab/genomebrowser-ui-v2 Docs

These docs are for users of `@weng-lab/genomebrowser-ui-v2`. They ship with the package and should be readable from `node_modules/@weng-lab/genomebrowser-ui-v2/docs`.

`@weng-lab/genomebrowser-ui-v2` provides user-interface components built on top of `@weng-lab/genomebrowser-v2`. It is for application code that wants higher-level browser UI pieces instead of only the lower-level browser runtime.

## Start here

- [TrackSelect](trackSelect.md): let users browse a catalog and add or remove tracks from a v2 track store.

Package docs are intentionally self-contained. They should not link to repository-root docs because those links break once the package is installed.
